title: Gas bill, Northern Power
description: A typed gas bill with meter readings and an m³ to kWh conversion: the model must take the kWh charged, not the volume.

title: Rates in pounds, Severn Valley
description: Quotes the unit rate as £0.1830/kWh, which must be stored as 18.3p, with a previous balance and payment to ignore.

title: Electricity bill, Cymru Gas & Power
description: The third supplier layout: different labels and date format, same fields to find.

title: Two pages with usage history
description: The second page is a 12-month usage table full of kWh figures that are not this bill's consumption.

title: Scanned bill
description: An image-only scan with no text layer, read by the vision model. Slow without a GPU: expect minutes.

title: Typed letter, scanned bill
description: A typed cover letter in front of a scanned bill: each page is read the right way, in one request.

title: The VAT trap
description: A short bill where small models often copy the total into the VAT field. The VAT checks catch it and send it to review.
